The '''Phattro system''' was located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Phattro/Legends|Phattro]] beverage.<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Phattro/Legends|Phattro]]|system=Phattro [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Phattro [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square S-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
